latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release—automatically keeps Clawdbot and all installed skills up to date.

- Sets up a daily cron job to check and apply updates for Clawdbot and skills.
- Sends a summary message detailing what was updated each day.
- Supports easy setup, manual controls, and troubleshooting guidance.
- Compatible with macOS and Linux.
